title: Google, Temasek, and Bain: online spending in SE Asia to rise ~17% YoY to $368B in 2026 despite economic headwinds, as businesses harness AI to spur spending (Gabrielle Ng/Bloomberg)
summary: Gabrielle Ng / Bloomberg: Google, Temasek, and Bain: online spending in SE Asia to rise ~17% YoY to $368B in 2026 despite economic headwinds, as businesses harness AI to spur spending — Artificial intelligence is helping Southeast Asia's digital economy deliver robust growth in the face of rising prices and teetering demand …
